headline: Software accelerates, federal drone slips trim outlook
summary_short: Axon Q3 revenue of $909M grew 28% y/y, with Software & Services up 43% to $437M. Non-GAAP EPS of $1.72 rose from $1.24, but full-year growth guidance fell to about 30%.
summary_long: Net income was $57M versus a $2M loss. Adjusted EBITDA reached $236M at a 25.9% margin. Free cash flow was an outflow of $19M as about $100M went to inventory. Full-year revenue is now guided to $3.61-$3.63B, down from 32%-34% growth, because three Federal Dedrone deployments worth about $130M are no longer expected in 2026. Q4 revenue is guided to $990M-$1.01B. Axon also announced a $1.2B Skydio investment.
confidence_notes: Source is the Q3 2026 shareholder letter (8-K exhibit). The 8-K cover exhibit resolved first was the separate Skydio announcement. Non-GAAP EPS delta computed from $1.72 vs $1.24. Guidance is stated in the summary text only; it was not written to the event shard (no sanctioned script).

drivers.explanation: Software & Services accelerated to 43% growth and Platform Solutions grew 106% to $125M; Connected Devices growth slowed on seasonality and an unrecognized Federal Dedrone deployment of about $30M.
Roughly $100M of cash went to a strategic inventory investment for product availability and supply chain resilience.
Operating leverage and a more favorable revenue mix led by accelerating Software & Services.
The full-year outlook cut is concentrated in three Federal Dedrone deployments totalling about $130M that are no longer expected in 2026.
